title: Dissecting the causal effects of interleukin receptor-related factors and the risk of developing endometriosis: a two-sample Mendelian randomization study.

claims.exposure_source: IEU OpenGWAS prot-a-1542 ('IL-6Rbeta'; prot-a series = Sun 2018 INTERVAL SomaScan)
claims.notes: Abstract only (Taylor & Francis bot verification page). Abstract reports 'significant causal associations' but no estimate or direction; robust after BMI/smoking adjustment (MVMR); IV F>10. IL-6Rbeta mapped to IL6ST (gp130). Abstract says reverse MR was null for prot-a-1530 and prot-b-38 only, so reverse MR for this protein may have been significant.

title: Causal association of cathepsins and endometriosis: A Mendelian randomization study.

claims.notes: 9 cathepsins tested; only cathepsin H significant at P<0.05 (no multiple-testing correction). Exposure SNPs P<5e-6, r2<0.001, PhenoScanner and MR-PRESSO filtering. FinnGen R9 subtypes: ovary OR 1.022 P=.046, pelvic peritoneum 1.046 P=.047, deep 1.050 P=.048. MVMR adjusted OR 1.034 P=.049. Reverse MR: endometriosis -> CTSH OR 1.017 P=.041. Preprint rs-3756621 (2023) is the same study with identical abstract estimates.

title: Associations between granulysin and ovarian endometriosis: A 2-sample Mendelian randomization study.

claims.exposure_source: IEU OpenGWAS GNLY (ENSG00000115523), stated as 'SSGAC', n=31,684 (ID and n match eQTLGen, Vosa 2021)
claims.notes: Single-exposure study; alpha 0.05, no multiple-testing correction. Exposure described as granulysin/'GNLY expression'; Ensembl gene ID and n suggest blood eQTL data, recorded as eQTL, tissue not stated. IVs P<5e-8, r2<0.001, 10,000 kb. Table 1: weighted median 0.87 (0.80-0.95) P=.003, MR-Egger 0.89 (0.79-0.99) P=.068, Q=9.06; text says WM/Egger P>.05 (disagrees with table). 3,231/68,969 matches FinnGen R5 ovarian endpoint.

title: Association Between Circulating Cytokines and Endometriosis: A Mendelian Randomization Study.

claims.notes: TRAIL. 41 cytokines; Bonferroni P<0.0012. IVs P<1e-5, r2<0.1 within 500 kb. Abstract gives beta=-0.061. WM OR 0.93, MR-Egger OR 0.92; Q P=0.594; Egger intercept P=0.222. qRT-PCR checked DSG2 (MAGMA/WGCNA gene), not TNFSF10, in 5 endometrioma vs 5 control endometria.
